messages:
miko: Quick one — post-launch we're drowning in small asks. Propose a 1-page fastpatch playbook + 48h triage rota to avoid "loudest-first" prioritization. Thoughts?

andre: Yes. Short playbook = who decides, what qualifies, comms checklist.

sam: Distinguish UX tweaks vs functional regressions. UX -> next minor unless customer-blocking.

yasmin: Minimal ticket fields please: severity, #customers, repro, workaround, est effort, account owner.

miko: Draft slash template: `/fastpatch request <ISSUE>` with those fields. Decision rule: fastpatch if regression/security OR P2+ affecting >=3 paying customers OR no workaround.

andre: Add cost sanity check: if est_effort > 3d and impact medium, schedule instead.

sam: SRE: need standard canary/rollback defaults. @sre-bot?

sre-bot: Recommend canary 5%/10m -> 25%/10m -> 100% if healthy. Auto-rollback on error spike or latency >2x. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/fastpatchs

yasmin: Add acceptance criteria: smoke tests, artifact+changelog, requester ack, post-deploy verif. Notify accounts for P2+.

miko: Ops: rotate 48h triage owner from oncall/product; owner must reply within 48h or escalate.

andre: I'll take rota week 1.

sam: I'll pair with SRE to produce the smoke checklist.

miko: Action items: miko -> publish 1-pager + slash template; andre -> week1 rota; sam -> smoke checklist; yasmin -> add fields to ticket template. Will post draft in #product-docs EOD.

andre: No objections. :rocket: 

sre-bot: Fastpatch runbook linked above.
